name: Jingheng Huan
description: The personal website of Jingheng Huan, also known as Matty Huan. Software projects, writing, YouTube, and Talking Laughs.
bio: I'm Jingheng Huan, also known as Matty Huan. I live in New York, build software, and share conversations on Talking Laughs. This is where I bring together my work, writing, and love of music, books, and film.
